items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We went over to Rudy Van Gelder’s so we – the best sound possible.

ctx.x: We got this gig at Paulson’s. Like I said, it was a perfect fit. Then we’re trying to figure out how to do this record. So we met with Don Sickler to find out which compositions were in Monk’s company, because a lot of them aren’t. Not a lot. Some of them weren’t. We wanted to make sure. So we found out which ones were. Then it was a question of lining up a studio. Rehearsing, lining up a studio, and paying for it. We used our own money to pay for the recording. We certainly – we didn’t have to pay ourselves. We…
Was that coming from the record company? Or did you guys have a separate publicist?
